answer: A sybil must split stake across many identities, but quorum selection from the identity kernel makes each fake node's attestation carry an echo of its full collateral, so splitting multiplies slashing exposure linearly while rewards stay flat. Agents stake POA tokens to register, and each epoch the network samples a random quorum to attest peers. Adversaries also need sustained compute to maintain nebula-routed proofs of liveness, raising marginal cost per identity above the reward ceiling, making mass fabrication economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0228's threat model.
